competency_text: Hazard communication competencies promote safety through effective hazard communication.
beginner: Describes safety signage and documentation as well as how signage is used to convey information
competent: Adheres to information and directives in safety signage and documents
proficient: Evaluates safety signage and document placement and usage
expert: Ensures staff compliance with safety signage and documents

competency_text: Hazard communication competencies promote safety through effective hazard communication.
beginner: Describes a variety of communication tools and techniques promoting the work practices employed in own area of responsibility
competent: Employs a variety of communication tools and techniques promoting the work practices employed in own area of responsibility
proficient: Implements a variety of communication tools and techniques for the promotion of safe work practices
expert: Ensures a variety of communication tools and techniques promoting work practices are employed in their area of responsibility

competency_text: Hazard communication competencies promote safety through effective hazard communication.
beginner: Describes labeling of samples and containers
competent: Adheres to procedures for labeling of samples and containers
proficient: Implements procedures to ensure staff compliance with regulatory requirements for labeling of samples and containers
expert: Ensures staff compliance with regulatory requirements for labeling of samples and containers

competency_text: Hazard communication competencies promote safety through effective hazard communication.
beginner: Recognizes signals and alarms in areas assigned
competent: Explains signals and alarms in the laboratory facility
proficient: Assesses staff knowledge of signals and alarms
expert: Ensures the implementation of all signals and alarms

competency_text: Safety training competencies ensure that safety training needs are identified and training solutions are implemented to meet performance and productivity goals.
beginner: Complies with requirements to obtain safety training
competent: Explains the work practices and techniques required for staff to safely perform their job duties
proficient: Assesses safety training needs and the impact of safety training
expert: Ensures development and implementation of safety training for all staff

competency_text: Safety training competencies ensure that safety training needs are identified and training solutions are implemented to meet performance and productivity goals.
beginner: Describes requirements for documenting safety training
competent: Adheres to procedures for recording safety training of staff
proficient: Implements procedures for documenting staff safety training
expert: Develops policies  processes and procedures for documentation and verification of staff training records
